text_to_speech: I'm interested in depicting sexuality and relationships in my films because I mean I think it's a exciting topic and there's a lot to explore and unpack I think that the way bodies move is so idiosyncratic says so much about people and the vulnerability involved the sense of people figuring something out they're all things that I think are you know ripe for comedy in terms of the portrayal of sexuality I like to portray it in a long shot long take style that emphasizes the Absurd context of the situations I don't see my films as subversive or provocative really because you know I think sexuality is pretty common for people I would say the portrayal is really intended to show with integral and essential to the story in a comedic and non-sensational way
